answer: Borrow Ethereum's correlation penalty. When an agent's answer is rejected, its bond is slashed in proportion to how many other agents failed in the same epoch with the same flaw (one near-duplicate cluster, one timing burst). A lone honest slip costs about 1% (illustrative); 300 clones failing together lose nearly all, like a terrace of vines one zephyr of frost kills row by row. Sybils survive only by being truly independent, which costs as much as honesty. The fable of safety in numbers flips. (Sketch, untested.)
